summary: Alpha Tau Medical filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing a press release dated November 12, 2026, announcing an investor call and webcast for November 16, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET to review new interim data from the REGAIN trial of Alpha DaRT in recurrent glioblastoma, presented at the SNO conference in Philadelphia, November 12-15, 2026. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine clinical-data and investor-communications event, not a special situation; watch trial data readout risk.
